Attach files listed two PDFs, Remove dropped one, the post carried the other and it downloaded with a Content-Disposition attachment; File was offered on the Contract attachment. Edit then Cancel left the text, Save showed edited, Delete asked Delete this comment? and left Comment deleted by its author.; her own menu had no Redact, another author's comment had no actions, and the edit form had no audience control. History listed 25 entries newest first and Show older brought 50. She saw Jonas Weber's Portal replies at Full thread on C-33 and in the R-16 Comments panel on the Inbox page, which has no History control.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

Mail absence was observed for 3 seconds after each controlled event once the Mailpit queue had settled, paired with positive deliveries through the same worker; this bounds the lab, not an arbitrary relay.

Filing an attachment, the Administrator lead-time procedure, and Document Versions were not performed; their guides (DOC-017, DOC-021) are unpublished and both articles stay in review until they pass.
The morning rounds were queued by the reviewer rather than waiting for the hourly cron; the worker served them with its real clock and rules.
Filing an attachment links to the unpublished Document guide (DOC-017); the article stays in review until that target passes.
